localizedDescriptions.en: Inspect and edit the open design file in Paper Desktop on the same computer.
localizedDescriptions.zh-CN: 在同一台电脑上查看和编辑 Paper Desktop 当前打开的设计文件。

en: Summarize the open design file and list the styles used by the selected design.
zh-CN: 概述当前打开的设计文件，列出所选设计使用的样式。

instructions.en: Open a design file in Paper Desktop on the same computer as NeuxBot Core. Keep Paper Desktop and the file open while using the connection.
instructions.zh-CN: 在运行 NeuxBot Core 的同一台电脑上打开 Paper Desktop 和设计文件。使用期间保持应用和文件开启。
